finding_status.notes: DiffComputedState tri-state ('computing' init); showVisualToggle = diffComputedState === 'has-diff'; toggle invisible until onHasDiff fires via useLayoutEffect.
resetKeyRef encodes `${selectedValue}:${activeBaselineTab}`; inline render-time reset when key changes covers both selectedValue and activeBaselineTab transitions.
baselineYaml set to '' when activeBaselineTab='previous' and previousEntry is absent; silentDeserialize returns null for empty string, triggering onParseError.
aria-pressed={viewMode === 'yaml'} and aria-pressed={viewMode === 'visual'} on toggle buttons; baseline tab buttons also carry aria-pressed={isActive}.

Baseline tab switcher rendered directly in WorkflowVersionHistoryPopup outside VersionHistoryDiffView, always visible. VersionHistoryDiffView accepts activeTab prop (controlled mode) and hides its own tabs when controlled.
onParseError, onNoDiff, onHasDiff all wrapped in useCallback([]) — stable references across parent re-renders.
silentDeserialize: `if (!yamlStr || !yamlStr.trim()) return null` added as first guard before yaml.load.
useLayoutEffect replaces useEffect for onParseError/onNoDiff/onHasDiff notification; parent state update batched with initial render.
useMemo returns full object {canvasConfig, baselineConfig, statusById, diff}; diff.nodes accessed via destructure at render time — no second diffWorkflowGraphs call.
removedNodes built via buildNodes(baselineConfig) → baselineBuiltById.get(n.id); spread preserves parentId and all ReactFlow node fields.
Same buildNodes(baselineConfig) fix preserves full node data (label, domain fields) and position; no nodes stack at origin.
removedBaselineEdges = buildEdges(baselineConfig).filter(e => removedIds.has(e.source) || removedIds.has(e.target)) with 'removed' stroke; included in allEdges.
diffNodeTypes wrapped in useMemo([], []) with comment noting nodeTypeComponents is module-level constant; prevents ReactFlow node remounts on parent re-render.

neutralFallback() = getTailwindColor('--colors-border-primary', 'gray'); badgeTextColor = getTailwindColor('--colors-text-primary', 'black'); edgeColor fallback uses same neutralFallback. No hardcoded hex.
DiffNodeWrapper style: `...(diffStatus === 'removed' ? { textDecoration: 'line-through' } : {})` applied to the wrapper div.
stableJson recurses: each value serialized via `stableJson((obj as Record<string, unknown>)[k])`; nested object key order no longer produces false positives.
promoteToModified: `if (existing.status !== 'added')` guard prevents overwriting 'added' status; added states referencing changed actors remain 'added'.
warnDuplicateStateIds logs console.warn on duplicate state IDs; called for both canvas and baseline arrays before Map construction.
linebg-modified: [c['yellow']['700'], c['yellow']['100']] — heavy dark / light light, matching linebg-add [green.900, green.50] and linebg-remove [red.900, red.75] convention.
mockVisualCallsParseError flag and test 'hides the Visual toggle when WorkflowVisualDiffView signals onParseError' added; asserts toggle absent after parse-error signal.
Previous-baseline routing test clicks 'Previous Version' tab and asserts data-baseline attribute changes to previousEntry.yaml_config; mock exposes baselineYaml as data-baseline.
